title.narrative: Integrated Multi-sectoral Humanitarian Response to Communities Severely Affected by the War in Sudan

description.narrative: Norwegian Church Aid (NCA), in partnership with CAFOD and national NGOs Caritas Sudan and Volunteers National Organization for Development and Humanitarian Services, proposes a 12-month integrated, multi-sectoral emergency response to address the urgent needs of vulnerable communities affected by the ongoing war in Sudan. Targeting internally displaced persons (IDPs) and host communities in hard-to-reach Central Darfur—classified under IPC 4 food insecurity and White Nile, one of the states with the highest IDP populations- the project aims to improve access to life-saving WASH, protection, and specialized GBV-related health services. With a strong focus on women, children, and people with disabilities, the action will provide clean water, sanitation facilities, hygiene support, GBV case management, psychosocial support, and community-based protection services. A crisis modifier will allow rapid adaptation to new emergencies, while the initiative builds on prior successful collaborations in Gedaref and current operations in the targeted states. Local partners will play a central role in delivering sustainable, community-led responses that ease pressure on overburdened host communities and ensure timely, inclusive, and impactful humanitarian action.
